explanation: The sentence 'The office sanctioned me the loan' is in active voice and in simple past tense.
Structure: Subject + had + V3 + Object → Active Past Perfect Tense.
Structure: Subject + had + V3 + Object → Active Past Perfect Tense.
Structure: Subject + V2 + Object → Active, Simple Past Tense.
Structure: Subject + is/am/are + V-ing + Object → Active, Present Continuous Tense.
Structure: Subject + is/am/are + V-ing + Object → Active, Present Continuous Tense.
Structure: Subject + V2 + Object → Active, Simple Past Tense.
Structure: Subject + V2 + Object + Preposition + Object → Active, Simple Past Tense.
Structure: Subject + V2 + a few + Object → Active, Simple Past Tense.
Structure: Subject + V1 + Object → Active, Simple Present Tense.
Structure: Subject + V2 + Object → Active, Simple Past Tense.
Structure: Subject + had + V3 + Object → Active, Past Perfect Tense.
Structure using modals: Subject + Modal + V1 + Object (Active Voice) → Subject + Modal + be + V3 + by + Agent (Passive Voice).
Structure in Past Indefinite: Subject + was/were + V3 + by + Agent (Passive Voice) ↔ Subject + V2 + Object (Active Voice).
Structure in Past Indefinite: Subject + was/were + V3 + by + Agent (Passive Voice) ↔ Subject + V2 + Object (Active Voice).
Structure of Interrogative Sentence (Past Tense): Question word + was + V3 + by + Agent (Passive Voice) ↔ Question word + Subject + V2 (Active Voice).
Past Progressive Passive structure: Subject + was/were + being + V3 + Object. Active form: Subject + was/were + V-ing + Object.
Example: 'Gun-toting guards were guarding the main gate.' Structure in Past Continuous: Subject + was/were + being + V3 + by + Agent (Passive) ↔ Subject + were + V-ing + Object (Active).
Example: 'The inadequate rainfall adversely affected the crop.' Past Simple Passive structure: Subject + was + Adverb + V3 + by + Object ↔ Subject + Adverb + V2 + Object (Active).
Example: 'Children are painting the wall of the park.' Present Continuous Passive structure: Subject + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Object ↔ Subject + is/am/are + V-ing + Object (Active).
Example: 'The police was removing the injured to the hospital.' Past Continuous Passive structure: Subject + were/was + being + V3 + by + Object ↔ Subject + was + V-ing + Object (Active).
Example: 'The custom officers were thoroughly checking one of the passengers.' Past Progressive Passive structure: Subject + was/were + being + Adverb + V3 + by + Object.
Example: 'The staff was arranging the chairs in the examination hall.' Past Continuous Passive structure: Subject + were + being + V3 + by + Object ↔ Subject + was + V-ing + Object.
Example: 'Everyone was laughing at the hunchback.' Past Continuous Passive structure: Subject + was + being + V3 + by + Object ↔ Subject + was + V-ing + Object.
Example: 'Ring the bell every forty minutes.' Imperative Passive structure: Let + Object + be + Past Participle.
Example: 'The enemy will either take you prisoner or shoot you.' Future Passive structure: Subject + will + be + V3 + by + Object ↔ Subject + will + V1 + Object.
Example: 'This scheme will greatly benefit us all.' Future Simple Passive structure: Subject + will + be + Adverb + V3 + by + Object ↔ Subject + will/shall + Adverb + V1 + Object.
